Our Story

Built by security professionals, for security professionals.

PatrolPilot was founded by a team of former security operations managers across the USA, UK and UAE who were frustrated with outdated, disconnected tools. We built the platform we always wished we had.

Book a Demo Get in Touch
Our Mission

Raising the standard of security management globally

Too many security companies across the USA, Canada, UK, UAE and Singapore are still running on spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and paper logs. We built PatrolPilot to change that — making enterprise-grade security management accessible to companies of all sizes.

Our team spans the USA, UK, UAE and Singapore with direct experience managing security operations, which means every feature in PatrolPilot solves a real problem we've personally faced on the ground.

What We Stand For

Our values

Security First

We hold our own platform to the same standard we expect from the companies using it — no compromises on data security.

Customer Obsessed

Every product decision starts with the security manager. We talk to customers weekly and ship based on real operational feedback.

Global Thinking

Built from day one to serve security companies across different regions, regulatory frameworks and working cultures.

Data Transparency

We believe in giving managers accurate, real-time data — not polished summaries that hide what's actually happening on the ground.
